label: synthetic fixture: invented outages and invented prices; a method demonstration, not a measurement
notes: No row, unit name, region figure or price comes from an export. The units SYN_* are invented. The prices rise by an invented slope per MW lost during each invented outage (CLUZ 2.0, CVIS 8.0, CMIN 5.0 PHP/MWh per MW), so the study must recover about those slopes. The invented demand is constant per region (CLUZ 10000, CVIS 2000, CMIN 2500 MW), so a response per MW over demand is the slope times that demand. SYN_L15 and SYN_L16 overlap on purpose and are left out. The two realtime files exist only to be refused.
